source_text: Today we are releasing GPT-7 Mini, a small reasoning model for developers. It scores 81% on SWE-bench Verified and supports tool calling and structured outputs in the API. Developers can use it through the Responses API with a 400K token context window. We trained it with reinforcement learning on agentic coding tasks, and it is available today to all paid tiers.
